author: Leila Gharani
description:
Personalize Copilot in Excel so it formats your tables, dates, and numbers your way, automatically. Microsoft just added personalization to Copilot in Excel, and in this video I show you exactly how to set it up.

Tired of reformatting everything Copilot hands you? You can teach it once how you like things, and it remembers across every workbook. I walk through the four settings I use, then test them live (honest result included), and finish with a list of other preferences worth adding.
